title: Platform-ecosystem prior-art extract queue
description: The ONE intermediate index, written once at merge and then FROZEN. Its ORDER is the contract: rows are spawned in cursor slices, so a reordered queue re-spawns work already done under a key that no longer matches.

queue.description: One admitted (platform, mechanism) pair per row, in spawn order, carrying every param the extract spawn declares.

item_id.description: The canonical id, `<platform>__<angle>`. The record's filename derives from it.

id_class.description: The platform type this row's platform carries.

location.description: The corpus URL the child reads.

found_by_angle.description: Comma-joined, because every spawn param is a string.
